$comment: The source of sf-button-copy's element plumbing (core/js/element-manifest.js). Taken from simai/ui-control control/smart-architecture/migration/out/copy-button (migration/convert-1.3.8.mjs over simai/ui-source@5100227); standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8, vocabulary 1.1.5. Every x-todo of the conversion is decided: x-decisions says how.

target.summary: #id of an input (its value) or an element (its text; a numbered code block without its numbers). value and target together are an error.

text.summary: A visible label; empty draws an icon-only button.

label.summary: The accessible name, saying what is copied («Скопировать команду»); «Копировать» / Copy by default.

copy.summary: Copies as a press would; a press while a copy is in flight is ignored.

x-returns.description: A promise of {text, method}, or null on failure.

default.$comment: The Lit template in JavaScript, the migration form of §5.2 (§16): the build does not compile template.html yet, so a second copy of the markup would only drift from the one that draws.

accessibility.$comment: The control is the native button of the sf-button (with text) or the sf-icon-button (icon only) the template draws; the result is said by a polite status. Enter and Space press the native button.

aliases.$comment: Dated aliases of sf-button-copy for the shim (stands/18-aliases-ci/alias.mjs, standard §16 item 20). mode: same-detail (the shim sends the new and the old name), split / detail-adds (a detail adapter, refused by the shim), attribute-and-property, method, property, manifest-only (the DOM name does not change), host-attribute (no shim), retired.

rows.summary: The value was not copied; on denied the text was selected for Ctrl+C.

rows.section: rename plan R0 (ui-control RENAME-PLAN-2026-11-03), naming decision 2026-11-02
rows.note: the element is sf-button-copy; sf-copy-button is a subclass defined beside it until the date
the event name carries the tag

x-summary: Copies a value or a target's text, confirms with a check and a polite announcement, and selects the text for Ctrl+C when the browser refuses the clipboard.
x-renamed: events.sf-copy → copied: a fact takes the past form (vocabulary §5.1); sf-copy-button-copied, the old sf-copy its dated alias
events.sf-copy-error → copy-failed: the fact of a refused copy; sf-copy-button-copy-failed, the old sf-copy-error its dated alias
settings.duration: type string with the numeral default "2000" → number (§16 item 29)
x-decisions: own-verb-words: the copy happened is a fact, so it takes the past form (vocabulary §5.1): copied {text, method}; a refused copy is copy-failed {code} -- the vocabulary's failed is a stream's end with {id, reason, message}, not this. Both are own verbs whose words are events.<name>.label of the language files. The old sf-copy and sf-copy-error are dated same-detail aliases (aliases.json, until 2026-12-01).
version 1.1.0: the events are renamed behind dated aliases, and copy() answers an outcome (§4.4) where it answered {text, method} or null.

copy is the action (waits): it answers {outcome: applied, text, method}, {outcome: refused, reason: <code> | busy}, or cancelled when the element is removed while the clipboard is asked. The template's press calls it.
key-effects: the control is the native button of the sf-button or sf-icon-button the template draws; Enter and Space press it (native activation, not an effect of the closed list), Tab reach.
words: the runtime words (copy, copied, failed, selected) are the language files', read with sfWord; the module's COPY_TEXT is gone.
duration is a number (integer, min 0, default 2000); its getter keeps a negative or empty value at 2000.
template: templates.default names the Lit template js/templates/default.js, the migration form §5.2 allows; no template.html until the build compiles one (a copy nothing draws would drift).
examples: examples.json from studio.fixture.json (a command, labelled) plus a target, a visible text, an icon of its own and a size.

css-variables: five public variables of the copy button's own sheet (the host's display and alignment, the pending opacity, the success and error ink), listed in src/core/contracts/public-variables.v1.json; the control's own look is sf-button's and sf-icon-button's variables.

version 1.1.1: the first-paint snapshots are retaken: the JSON island is printed once (no held copy), the icon font's state (sf-icon loaded, sf-icon-loaded) is left out, a closed surface prints closed and a size or place the code measured (a non-zero px width, height, inset, clip or transform) is left out, so a snapshot is the same on every run.
version 1.1.2: the first-paint sheet list names the utility sheets its templates draw with (core.runtime 1.0.7 asks for them before the element draws: the style gate).

version 1.1.3: the control sits in a line of text by its middle (--sf-copy-button-vertical-align, default middle, now on the wrapper .sf-copy-button: the host is display: contents, so the variable never reached a box). Aligned by its baseline it took the icon glyph's, and an sf-icon is font-size 0 until the icon runtime marks it loaded: the button rode 1 px lower and the line under it grew by 1 px until then, which first-paint gate 24 saw only when the full run loaded the page late enough.

version 1.1.5: the bundle carries no element layer of its own -- element-manifest, aliases, the alias table, the host port, deprecations, page actions, the layer stack, the open-surface mark and the instance path come from the page's shared runtime (SF.runtimeModule, runtime ABI 1, core.runtime 1.1.0), one instance per page -- and embeds of this file only the keys the runtime reads. Behaviour unchanged.

version 1.1.8: the copy and its fallback are core's (core/js/clipboard.js, SF.copyText, core.runtime 1.20.0), shared with the clipboard class (reuse audit 2026-11-02, finding 11). The same order -- the Clipboard API on a secure page, execCommand over a hidden field where it is absent or refused -- and the same outcomes.

version 1.2.0: the tag is sf-button-copy (naming decision 2026-11-02: sf-[set]-<block>[-<variant>]); the folder, the id smart.button-copy and the bundle cl-button-copy follow it. sf-copy-button stays a dated alias until 2027-01-01: a subclass the Smart base defines beside the new tag, listed in the rule, in sheets as :is(sf-button-copy, sf-copy-button) (change journal tag-sf-copy-button-to-sf-button-copy, path-smart-copy-button-to-button-copy).

version 1.2.1 (2026-11-08): the keys a person presses are the button family's (msg-c84f2727): Tab reaches the button, Enter and Space press it -- the manifest listed Enter and Space without Tab. Settings, values, events and the drawing are unchanged.

version 1.2.2 (2026-11-08): a patch, nothing drawn differently by this element. Its first-paint sheet list names the kbd sheet (component.kbd 1.1.0, docs review R030): sf-button 1.8.0 draws a shortcut's keys with it, and every component that draws an sf-button asks for it before the first paint. Settings, values, events and keys unchanged.

forbidden_client_responsibilities: saving the width on a server

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-button-copy to copy an identifier, a key, a command or a code block, naming each button by what it copies.
do_not: Do not copy generated ui-smart code
Do not leave several icon-only copy buttons named only «Копировать»

accessibility.focus: An ordinary button named by label (what is copied); the result is announced in a polite status; a refused clipboard selects the text and says to press Ctrl+C (⌘C on macOS).

sf-copy-error.summary: The value was not copied; on denied the text was selected for Ctrl+C.
